description: How much must adrenal secretion fall in CBG deficiency to reproduce the blunted free glucocorticoid surge reported in Cbg-/- mice?
code:
import numpy as np, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from scipy.integrate import solve_ivp
from scipy.optimize import brentq
Vp,Kd,BMAX,K_ALB,CL = 3.5,30.0,700.0,3.4,25.0
def g(F,Bmax): return (1.0+K_ALB)+Bmax*Kd/(Kd+F)**2
def run(Bmax,scale=1.0,mult=6.0,T=8.0):
    S0=250.0*scale; F0=S0/CL
    def S(t):
        if t<0.5: return S0
        if t<1.0: return S0*mult
        return S0*(1.0+(mult-1.0)*np.exp(-(t-1.0)/0.33))
    ts=np.linspace(0,T,4001)
    s=solve_ivp(lambda t,y:[(S(t)-CL*max(y[0],0))/(Vp*g(max(y[0],0),Bmax))],
                (0,T),[F0],t_eval=ts,rtol=1e-9,atol=1e-11,max_step=0.01)
    return ts,s.y[0]
_,Fw=run(BMAX); wt_peak=Fw.max(); wt_basal=Fw[0]
sc=np.linspace(0.15,1.0,60)
pk=np.array([run(0.0,scale=s)[1].max() for s in sc])/wt_peak
bs=np.array([run(0.0,scale=s)[1][0] for s in sc])/wt_basal
need={q:brentq(lambda s: run(0.0,scale=s)[1].max()/wt_peak-q,0.1,1.0) for q in (0.5,0.6,0.7,0.8,1.0)}
print("required null adrenal secretion (fraction of normal) to achieve a given free-peak ratio")
print("free_peak_ratio,secretion_fraction,resulting_basal_free_ratio")
rows=[]
for q,s in need.items():
    b=run(0.0,scale=s)[1][0]/wt_basal
    rows.append((q,s,b)); print(f"{q:.2f},{s:.3f},{b:.3f}")

fig,ax=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(11,4.2))
ax[0].plot(sc*100,pk,lw=2,color='#b2283c',label='stress free peak, null / normal')
ax[0].plot(sc*100,bs,lw=2,color='#2b6cb0',label='resting free, null / normal')
ax[0].axhline(1,color='grey',ls='--',lw=1); ax[0].axhline(0.5,color='grey',ls=':',lw=1)
ax[0].axvline(need[0.5]*100,color='#b2283c',ls=':',lw=1)
ax[0].set_xlabel('adrenal secretion in CBG null (% of normal)')
ax[0].set_ylabel('ratio to CBG-normal'); ax[0].legend(frameon=False)
ax[0].set_title('A blunted free surge needs a ~70% cut in secretion,\nwhich also halves resting free cortisol')
for s,c,l in [(1.0,'#777','secretion 100% of normal'),(need[0.5],'#b2283c','secretion 30% of normal')]:
    t,F=run(0.0,scale=s); ax[1].plot((t-0.5)*60,F,lw=2,color=c,label=f'CBG null, {l}')
t,F=run(BMAX); ax[1].plot((t-0.5)*60,F,lw=2,color='#2b6cb0',label='CBG normal')
ax[1].set_xlabel('time from stress onset (min)'); ax[1].set_ylabel('free cortisol (nmol/L)')
ax[1].legend(frameon=False); ax[1].set_title('Free cortisol trajectories')
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
